results.description:
'Utterly hilarious and thrillingly disgusting' Miriam Margoyles

'Perfectly ridiculous and very funny' Dawn French

An unsolved case. A plot to win the ratings. But will it end in murder?

Jayne enjoys her new job as a researcher on popular daytime TV programme Morning All!, but the usual fare of cookery and fashion items are a bit bland and ratings are plummeting.

So when Jayne comes up with the idea for a segments investigating cold case murders - where the viewers can help to solve the mystery - the show knows they've hit the jackpot.

The trouble is, these cutthroat execs will do anything to keep the newly boosted ratings. And when a fresh case is needed, and fast, it might just turn to murder...

Discover this autumn's most entertaining, devious and fabulous mystery from author, actor and comedian Julian Clary.
